user.title: Connect to Sound Effects Studio
user.description: Enter the Studio host, port, and API token. To reconnect after a token change, enter the new token.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Sound Effects Studio
reconfigure.description: Update the Studio host, port, and API token.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Sound Effects Studio.

abort.already_configured: This Studio instance is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: Configuration for this Studio instance is already in progress.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to verify the discovered Studio instance.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Sound Effects Studio can be configured.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This address belongs to a different Studio instance.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: The Studio discovery information is invalid.
abort.invalid_auth: The discovered API token was rejected.

init.title: Sound Effects options
init.description: Set the media URL, optional season entity, and catalog polling interval.

data_description.public_base_url: Leave empty to use Home Assistant's configured URL.
data_description.season_entity: Optional entity whose state matches a season ID or name.
data_description.scan_interval: Time between Studio updates, from 10 to 3600 seconds.

select.name: Select sound
select.description: Select a sound from the locally cached catalog without repeating until the eligible sounds have been played. Returns audio details for use in automations.

category.name: Category
category.description: Category ID or name to select from.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Require all listed tags. Accepts a list or comma-separated text.

season.name: Season
season.description: Season ID or name for this selection. Omit to use the active season. Falls back to regular when no sounds match.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Preview a selection without changing history, firing an event, or reporting to Studio.

reset_history.name: Reset history
reset_history.description: Clear shuffle bags and last selections for a category, or for all categories when omitted.

category.name: Category
category.description: Optional category ID or name. Omit to reset all categories.

refresh.name: Refresh catalog
refresh.description: Request the latest catalog from Sound Effects Studio. Cached selection remains available while Studio is offline.

unknown_category.message: The requested category does not exist.

unknown_season.message: The requested season does not exist.

no_eligible_sound.message: No eligible sound was found in category {category}.

not_loaded.message: Sound Effects is not loaded. Set up the integration before using this action.
